name: 77071 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77071 (Houston) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (52% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77071 (Houston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77071 (Houston) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
